name: openpnp_get_capabilities
description: Discover this bridge build, genuine simulator attestation, supported tools, and qualification limits before choosing a workflow.

name: openpnp_get_status
description: Observe machine and job state without enabling, moving, feeding, or probing the machine. Use view:progress for repeated polls and full for selected detailed snapshots. Native timestamps and unknown observations remain unchanged; progress does not archive full snapshots.

view.description: Use progress for repeated polls: bounded native state, IDs, counters, faults and supplied freshness, without retaining a full snapshot. Full (default) returns complete details with exact retained pagination when large. Read full once at pause/terminal for evidence; that read is a new observation.

name: openpnp_get_configuration
description: Read a native configuration snapshot and its revision; this does not save or modify configuration.

name: openpnp_request_control_session
description: Acquire a bounded native ownership lease. Automatic grant is limited to the native simulator; physical control requires the bridge local grant workflow.

name: openpnp_get_control_session
description: Read the native ownership lease and epoch without acquiring control.

name: openpnp_get_request_status
description: Reconcile a request by its original request ID after a lost response. Never generate a new ID to retry an unknown action. Use view:progress while polling, then full once when paused or terminal to retain complete evidence.

view.description: Use progress for repeated polls: bounded native state, IDs, counters, faults and supplied freshness, without retaining a full snapshot. Full (default) returns complete details with exact retained pagination when large. Read full once at pause/terminal for evidence; that read is a new observation.

name: openpnp_renew_control_session
description: Renew the existing native ownership lease.

name: openpnp_release_control_session
description: Release the existing native ownership lease.

name: openpnp_set_machine_enabled
description: Request machine enable or disable under native ownership. Disabling is not a hardware emergency stop.

name: openpnp_home_machine
description: Run the qualified native homing sequence, which can move axes. Returns an operation to observe.

name: openpnp_plan_motion
description: Validate and preview an absolute pose in the native machine frame under an existing session. Does not move. Execution rechecks state and ownership.

name: openpnp_execute_motion
description: Execute a native validated motion plan using its plan ID. Never reconstruct or retry a lost physical action.

name: openpnp_capture_camera
description: Capture a native raw or settled camera frame with camera and capture provenance through the native executor. Returns an operation and artifact.

name: openpnp_get_operation
description: Observe an admitted operation through completion, failure, or outcome-unknown. Use view:progress for polling, then full once when paused or terminal for complete evidence. While running, an earlier result can remain from a prior pause; get_status.job_progress provides separately timestamped counts. Client cancellation does not stop physical motion.

view.description: Use progress for repeated polls: bounded native state, IDs, counters, faults and supplied freshness, without retaining a full snapshot. Full (default) returns complete details with exact retained pagination when large. Read full once at pause/terminal for evidence; that read is a new observation.

name: openpnp_get_events
description: Read sequenced native events. On resync_required, reread authoritative snapshots instead of inferring missing state.

name: openpnp_prepare_job
description: Prepare a native OpenPnP job from the bundled pnp-test fixture or a previously imported canonical artifact. Native validation requires compatible packages, tooling, and feeders. This does not start production.

name: openpnp_validate_job
description: Check the currently loaded native job model and return an operation with prerequisites. The native processor performs its own preflight when the job starts; model validation does not prove placement quality.

name: openpnp_save_job
description: Save the current job and its referenced native board/panel definitions as a hash-verified document bundle. Preserves placed history and static transforms. This does not create a portable machine backup.

name: openpnp_load_job
description: Reload a native document bundle saved in this installation’s owned document store, including after a bridge restart. Verifies its private receipt and component dependencies, preserves recorded placement history, and requires fresh job validation and alignment. Accepts an artifact ID, never a path or arbitrary XML.

name: openpnp_get_board_loads
description: Read native root and descendant board-load identities, job and load revisions, facing sides, retained history, and required presence confirmations. Simulator records do not verify a physical board or underside clearance.

name: openpnp_register_board_load
description: Record an explicit simulator board replacement, flip, or same-load confirmation for an exact current native root. Requires the current load revision and, for any existing binding or flip/same-load, its expected_load_id. Returns an operation; invalidates registration and production validation. This records operator intent without verifying physical presence, clearance, or undoing placed material.

name: openpnp_inspect_job
description: Read a native executor-owned page of all real and derived placement records, including disabled holders, opposite sides, panel fiducials, X-outs and placed history. Returns an operation with exact native IDs and holder-local mm/degrees. Use current job/configuration/load revisions and the first page’s source_fingerprint as expected_source_fingerprint on later pages. Derived pseudo records are read-only. Does not change native job fields, move, or feed; the request receipt is retained.

name: openpnp_plan_placement_edits
description: Admit an executor-owned preview of typed edits to existing native placements. Returns an operation whose completed result contains plan_id and every affected instance. Bind exact current job/configuration/load revisions. job_instance affects one expanded holder; job_shared_definition affects its shared definition within this job. Coordinates are explicit local holder mm/in and degrees. No placement fields, machine position, feeds, or files change during planning; the request and plan receipt are retained.

name: openpnp_apply_placement_edits
description: Apply a reviewed native placement plan once under the same job, configuration, load revision and owner. Returns an operation. Changed placed records are rejected; unchanged history is preserved. Copies required shared definitions within this job, invalidates registration/validation and board-load bindings, and requires explicit load confirmation or replacement before production. Save the document separately. Does not move or feed the machine.

name: openpnp_plan_placement_structure
description: Preview adding or removing real placements/fiducials on existing boards in a trusted unused simulator job. Returns an operation whose completed result binds a plan, exact lineage/revision and every affected instance. Requires disabled machine, empty nozzles, complete empty current/retired native history and no prior processor admission. New records require every placement field and an existing part/package. Native coordinates are local holder mm/in and degrees. Pseudo-dependent removal, panel structural edits, renaming and reused logical IDs are refused. Planning retains a receipt without publishing placements.

name: openpnp_apply_placement_structure
description: Apply a reviewed structure plan once under the same native job/configuration/load/lineage and owner. Durably reserves touched logical IDs before publishing a detached job tree; invalidates job validation, cached plans, registration and load bindings. Pending or uncertain publication retains its reservation and cannot be retried. Save separately and explicitly rebind loads before revalidation. Does not move, feed, reset placed history or qualify hardware. Old documents and jobs without trusted unused lineage are refused.

name: openpnp_start_job
description: Start the selected validated native job under the existing control lease, returning an operation ID.

name: openpnp_step_job
description: Advance exactly one native processor next() call in the simulator, then wait for native standstill and return a paused or completed operation. A native step can include multiple motions/actions or no placement. Supply job_id to begin a validated job, or operation_id to advance its paused operation; choose exactly one and bind the current configuration revision. Reuse the original operation throughout the job. Repeated request IDs return its receipt without advancing again. Unknown outcomes require reconciliation.

name: openpnp_pause_job
description: pause the native job at its supported cooperative boundary; observe the returned state.

name: openpnp_resume_job
description: resume the native job at its supported cooperative boundary; observe the returned state.

name: openpnp_abort_job
description: Abort the native job; cleanup can move axes and discard parts. This is not an emergency stop.

name: openpnp_plan_configuration
description: Stage a revision-bound patch of supported native settings and shared-reference effects. Changes use explicit mm/degrees and replace the named setting group. Vision settings require a separate vision-only patch. Mapped-axis geometry requires a separate plan containing exactly one change; supported existing native links and transformed limits are revalidated before application. Native validation checks the whole patch before applying anything. No settings are applied by planning.

name: openpnp_apply_configuration
description: Apply and persist the selected typed native configuration plan under its current revision and lease.

name: openpnp_test_feeder
description: Advance one native feeder using the selected nozzle. A feed can consume material; this operation is not a passive check.

name: openpnp_control_actuator
description: Command one allowlisted native actuator. Returned command state is not independent physical feedback.

name: openpnp_change_nozzle_tip
description: Use the native nozzle-tip change sequence. Omit nozzle_tip_id to unload. This can move axes.

name: openpnp_backup_configuration
description: Save and snapshot the supported native configuration files into a bridge artifact. The result declares whether it is a complete portable backup.

name: openpnp_export_portable_configuration
description: Export the disabled, idle supported native simulator configuration as a portable ZIP artifact for fresh-instance adoption. Preserves seven native XML documents and inventoried images; scripts are quarantined. Empty board/panel libraries only. Transfers no operational history, physical authority or calibration qualification.

name: openpnp_export_run_report
description: Export a native run report with operation provenance and stated inspection limits through the native executor.

name: openpnp_get_native_artifact
description: Read a camera frame, backup, or report artifact from the connected native bridge by its native artifact ID.

name: openpnp_run_calibration
description: Run the supported native nozzle-tip runout routine under a control lease. This moves the simulator. Fitted offsets describe the native model; they are not independent residual measurements or hardware qualification.

name: openpnp_validate_calibration
description: Read the native nozzle-tip calibration model through the executor. Report validity and fitted offsets with their limits; this does not independently qualify hardware.

name: openpnp_locate_fiducials
description: Use OpenPnP native vision to locate fiducials for the current job and update board alignment. This may move the camera and change job coordinates.

name: openpnp_list_issues
description: Run a fresh native Issues & Solutions scan through the executor. Scanning updates native issue bookkeeping; returned issues are advisory and unsupported solutions cannot be auto-applied.

name: openpnp_restore_configuration
description: Restore the supported typed setting subset from a native backup made by this bridge instance. The result declares the restore scope; this does not restore physical position, material, or placement history.

name: openpnp_reconcile_operation
description: Explicitly abandon an unknown operation from a prior native simulator instance after a fresh simulator reset. Retains the unknown historical outcome and never replays it.

name: openpnp_import_job
description: Parse supplied KiCad position, reference CSV, or canonical JSON content into a deterministic local job artifact. Reports source rows, units, and unresolved data; does not touch the machine.

name: openpnp_validate_imported_job
description: Validate a local canonical job artifact and report unresolved heights, identities, side transforms, and placement requirements. No physical qualification is implied.

name: openpnp_get_artifact
description: Read an immutable local imported job artifact by SHA-256 identifier.

name: openpnp_read_response_page
description: Read a page from an exact locally retained large MCP response, without contacting the machine. JSON mode pages array items or object entries; bytes mode returns serialized JSON bytes (exact retained bytes at pointer ""); decoded-base64 mode returns original binary bytes from a selected base64 string. Follow count, next_offset and eof; oversized JSON items require child pointers or bytes mode. No arbitrary paths or prototype access.

limit.description: At most 500 values in JSON mode or 16384 bytes in either byte mode. The inline byte budget may return fewer JSON values.

name: openpnp_record_inspection
description: Evaluate explicitly supplied independent inspection measurements against supplied tolerances and persist an immutable receipt. Do not invent measurements or evidence. External evidence references are recorded, not independently authenticated; this tool never grants production or hardware qualification.

name: openpnp_assess_inspection_coverage
description: Check passing inspection coverage for the exact canonical job revision, supplied configuration revision, and physical board-load identity. Missing, stale, or uncertain evidence blocks coverage; coverage is distinct from native production authorization.
